title: Adhyaya 2: Avirodha (Non-Contradiction)
summary: Refutes rival philosophical schools (Sankhya, Vaisheshika, Buddhist, Jaina) and reconciles apparent contradictions.
ai_summary: Badarayana defends the Vedantic view against logical objections, proving that unconscious matter cannot organize the cosmos without consciousness.

verses.translation: If it be argued that there results the defect of leaving no room for certain Smritis (like Kapila's Sankhya), we reply no, because by adopting that, room would be denied to other Smritis (like Manu and Gita).

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: Smriti must be subordinated to Sruti. The Smritis of Manu and Vyasa confirm the Vedic view of Brahman as the cause.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: श्रुति के अनुकूल स्मृतियाँ ही प्रमाण हैं; सांख्य की स्वतंत्र प्रकृति श्रुति-सम्मत नहीं है।

verses.translation: And on account of the impossibility of the design and order of the universe, the inferred entity (insentient Pradhana) cannot be the cause.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: A wondrous, orderly universe cannot be designed by unthinking matter, just as a palace cannot be erected without an intelligent architect.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: संसार की अद्भुत व्यवस्था और रचना अचेतन प्रकृति द्वारा संभव नहीं है।

verses.translation: The non-difference of effect (the world) from the cause (Brahman) is established from words like 'originating from speech' and others.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: Just as pots and jugs are in truth nothing other than clay (Vacharambhanam vikaro namadheyam), so all names and forms are in essence Brahman alone.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: कार्य (जगत) और कारण (ब्रह्म) में अनन्यता है; जैसे मिट्टी के सभी पात्र वस्तुतः मिट्टी ही हैं।

verses.translation: For this very reason (of non-difference from Brahman), the individual soul (Jiva) is essentially an eternal knower / consciousness.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: The Jiva is not an inert product of nature; its core essence is self-luminous pure awareness.

layers.author: ramanujacharya
layers.content: The Jiva is an eternal conscious entity possessing Dharmabhuta Jnana (attributive consciousness).

verses.translation: The individual soul is a part/spark of the Supreme Lord, because of the declarations of difference as well as non-difference in scripture.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: The soul is an 'amsha' (part) only figuratively, as space in a jar is part of infinite space, delimited by limiting adjuncts (Upadhis).

layers.author: ramanujacharya
layers.content: जीवात्मा परमात्मा का नित्य अंश और शरीर-भूत है।
